item.title: Installing macOS on a Dell OptiPlex 7080MT
item.description: About ten years ago, I installed macOS on a laptop. The biggest headache back then was that only specific hardware could succeed, and drivers for all sorts of things were missing. Later I bought my own Mac laptop and stopped paying attention to how to install macOS on generic machines for a long time.
